footers.indo_pacific: Yangtze: wetter than a typical neutral summer in 4 of 8 for Jun–Aug and 6 of 8 for Jun–Jul (the Jun–Jul split was checked after the full-summer result). Central Pacific islands: satellite era only.
footers.india_note: India: a dry 2027 monsoon is not favoured (drier in 1 of 8 years after a strong El Niño)
footers.africa: Southern Africa's misses were 1957–58 and 1965–66. 1997–98 came in at 98% of the 1991–2020 average, and 2023–24, the driest of the eight, at 69%.
footers.sahel_note: Sahel: no reliable El Niño signal (drier in only 3 of 8 strong events)
footers.south_america: Peru / Ecuador coast: flooding rains in 1982–83 (207% of the 1991–2020 average) and 1997–98 (240%), both with very warm coastal water, as in 2026. Other strong events ranged from somewhat below to somewhat above average.
footers.north_america: S California missed only in 2015–16: the coast got 60–68% of its 1991–2020 average, though 9 of 10 models rerun from Sep 2015 predicted a wet winter.
